diagnostics.message: `aws_lambda_function.webhook` attaches a VPC configuration (`vpc_config` from `var.config.lambda_subnet_ids`/`lambda_security_group_ids`), and Lambda needs the `AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole` managed policy on its execution role *at creation time* to create the ENIs (else creation fails with "The provided execution role does not have permissions to call CreateNetworkInterface"). Nothing in the function references `aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.webhook_vpc_execution_role`, so Terraform may create the function in parallel with/before the attachment, making applies order-dependent. Add `depends_on = [aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.webhook_vpc_execution_role]` to the function.
